title: feature request: sync predictive simulation settings from nightscout profile
symptom: The user requests a feature to sync predictive simulation settings (insulin sensitivity and carb ratio) from the Nightscout profile into xDrip, so that these values do not have to be entered manually in xDrip.
evidence_quote: In xDrip predictive simulation settings are the profile values Insulin sensitivity and carb ratio. xDrip schould able to get this settings from the Nightscout Profile and also reread this settings If the Nightscout Profile has changed.
